files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: In riders.csv, write credit_balance as text with an explicit sign and two decimals (12.5 becomes +12.50, -3.2 becomes -3.20, zero becomes +0.00) and write n/a where the balance is empty. `result` should be a Series of these texts indexed by rider_id (text, leading zeros kept), in file order.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv keeping rider_id as text; write credit_balance as text with an explicit sign and two decimals (12.5 -> +12.50, -3.2 -> -3.20, 0 -> +0.00) and n/a for an empty balance; a Series indexed by rider_id in file order.
